description: Write a Python ETL script (pandas) for fintech_app that converts a fixed-width bank statement file to CSV. Record layout (1-based positions, every line is 61 characters): record_type 1; for detail records 'D': account 2-11, booking date 12-19 (YYYYMMDD), sign 20 ('+' or '-'), amount 21-31 (11 digits, implied 2 decimals), description 32-61 (space padded). The header record 'H' carries the file date in 2-9. The trailer record 'T' carries the detail record count in 2-11, the sign of the control total in 20 and the control total in 21-31. The script should: (1) parse detail records by position, (2) keep account as a string, (3) apply the sign and the implied decimals, (4) strip padding from the description, (5) verify record count and control total against the trailer and abort on mismatch, (6) write a properly quoted CSV.
edge_cases: Header and trailer records must not be emitted as data rows
Positions in the layout are 1-based and inclusive; Python slices and pandas colspecs are 0-based and half-open
The description 'RENT, MARCH' contains a comma and must be quoted in the CSV output
Trailer validation for the sample: 2 detail records and control total -874.50 (125.50 - 1000.00)
Account numbers must keep leading zeros
common_failure_modes: FM4: Off-by-one column offsets shift the sign into the amount or truncate the account
FM7: Trailer count and control total ignored, so truncated files load without error
FM5: Account parsed as integer loses leading zeros
